## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      3 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Jul 31, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nancy Richey_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "I cannot cancel this app in the trial period. The directions don't line up with the experience. If you are not positive you want this app, do NOT start the trial period."
            2. _Deanajk_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "I don’t even know where to start all I know is I don’t understand why you would change something that wasn’t broken! I’ve been a premium user for 15 years!? There are so many things wrong with the new layout/UI/update, and I don’t have time to list all of them here. But if you’ve been a user for a while, then you already know. Please please please bring back some of the old features that you omitted with the update! I never thought I’d have to say that I’m considering other ways to track my macros for the first time in many many years. It’s a sad day for me! 😭"
            3. _Southern Roots_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "What’s going on? I paid for premium content for a year. But now the app is not letting me have access to the premium content that I paid for. I am totally locked out. No way to “restore purchases” just an error on their end. This is so bad devs. Please do better."

## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

   **Ads pressure.**
      1 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Jul 23, 2026 - Jul 30, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _drawdraw300_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "Every. Single. Update. I am nothing but disappointed. The UI becomes harder to use, and uglier. Not only am i getting more ads- but not when i want to log for one meal, i see every meal first. If i want to delete logs, i can no longer select to delete or mass delete them. I firmly believe the developers are now more interest in AI and money than the quality of their app, and the comfort of their customers. I will be switching apps. Thanks for ruining your app for your YEARS long customer who kept giving you chances."
            2. _Rich Stafford_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "nearly worthless. mostly just ads to subscribe to their premium service."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Aug 1, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _cleverfan_, Jul 31, 2026, 1/5: "I have used MyFitnessPal daily for more than 1673 days with good results. The most recent software update mid to late June has caused ongoing errors that Customer Service is unable and/or unwilling to correct. I work with the Chatbot to report it 2 to 3 times but nothing happened. I found a support link and reached out. I got a reply on July 9. As of today, July 30, they continue to tell me they can’t fix the problem. They finally acknowledge that it is a known issue where the app does not calculate net cards correctly only total carbs. I get the sense from the Customer Service people that they kind of shrug their shoulders. There’s also a discrepancy in the number of days that I have used the app consistently that they can’t fully explain. I use the app for carbohydrate counting for insulin dosing. It’s very disappointing. Such a great app was ruined by an update that contained other bugs and added multiple steps to entries. While I don’t want to leave the app. I’m going to have to find another solution due to unnecessary changes, very very, very poor Customer Service, and a general, seeming lack of concern. At this point, I would find another app and not download this one."
            2. _Leigh McWhirter_, Jul 30, 2026, 1/5: "Latest update has ruined this app. It's basically unusable now."
            3. _Dorothy Doyle_, Jul 29, 2026, 1/5: "it was working fine til this last update now I cant get it it freezes before I can log in to the point I have shut down my phone"
